instructions: Report every case as PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN with evidence. Core cases are mandatory for the indicated owner; unsupported optional profiles must pass explicit rejection checks. Live data comparisons use the same captured snapshot, never these synthetic fixture prices.

phase_scopes.service: C01-C22 service-side assertions; shared client assertions are pending, not joint PASS
phase_scopes.client: client-side shared assertions plus C23-C24 project integration obligations
phase_scopes.joint: all applicable assertions in both ends, plus real observation before dataset promotion

legacy_reproduction.observed: five empty arrays with false partial/truncated and no errors; individual requests had bars
legacy_reproduction.expected_fix: same qualified identities/date/fq return equivalent data in v3; classify any genuine unavailable legacy data instead of reporting unexplained success

legacy_reproduction.observed: same empty result; limit=0 alone is not a confirmed root cause
legacy_reproduction.expected_fix: inspect multi-code SDK dispatch/normalization as well as limit; prove positive limit is correct

legacy_reproduction.observed: data was a flat list, not the project batch client's expected object
legacy_reproduction.expected_fix: v3 single/array-one/array-many always object keyed by qualified requested id; maintain documented legacy compatibility separately

core_cases.name: Protocol, tool discovery and contract opt-in
assertions: initialize and initialization notification follow the negotiated protocol
tools/list including all pages matches real accepted inputs and outputs
explicit v3 returns v3; unknown contract returns UNSUPPORTED_CONTRACT; omitted version retains legacy shapes
source commit/build identity and contract revision are reported independently

core_cases.name: Exact schema and public parameter boundary
assertions: all example requests and responses validate against the same schema
reject code+codes, empty/duplicate/>50 codes, unknown parameter, old comma fields string, negative limit, malformed/invalid dates, start>end
v3 raw 000001 returns AMBIGUOUS_INSTRUMENT
request/log fixtures contain public identifiers only, no portfolio/account/cost/quantity/private-label inputs

core_cases.name: Single and batch shape/equivalence
assertions: capture the batch, then query each code and each one-element codes array using that snapshot_id
data/meta are objects with exact requested keys in all three modes
within one snapshot, dates/OHLC/volume/amount/bar_state/units/source metadata agree for each id
do not hard-code prior observed market prices as current test truth

core_cases.name: Limit semantics
assertions: limit=0 returns every available row in the requested range
limit=10 on a known >10-row interval returns latest 10 rows per id in ascending order, partial=true and truncated=true
limit>=available returns complete if other gates pass
source/page/response cap never becomes successful empty data; incomplete available count is null rather than guessed

core_cases.name: Projection, row form and range
assertions: fields close/volume still returns row objects with date/bar_state/source_id
row fields exactly match projection plus mandatory identifiers
range endpoints inclusive, no out-of-range rows, no duplicate or unsorted dates
normalize field order and single code consistently before request hash

core_cases.name: Mixed security identity
assertions: XSHG/index/exchange/000001 and XSHE/equity/exchange/000001 cannot alias
a supported key returns the same instrument identity; an unsupported asset returns a typed error
equity/ETF namespace and exchange are verified against public identity evidence, not guessed from name/prefix
no extra/unrequested security key appears in data/meta

core_cases.name: Legitimate empty with evidence
assertions: proven suspension/pre-listing/post-delisting gaps carry public source evidence covering every missing date
zero-calendar-session query can be complete/empty with expected_rows=0
no synthetic flat Kline or fake zero volume fills suspension gaps
lack of evidence prevents empty/complete even if source returned []

core_cases.name: Unknown empty regression
assertions: batch all-empty while pinned single records exist must fail correctness tests
unknown gap -> INCOMPLETE_COVERAGE and failed/partial, is_partial=true
errors=[] plus false partial/truncated cannot disguise missing expected dates
available_rows and returned_rows counts do not change the expected calendar slots

core_cases.name: Per-code failure
assertions: inject one code timeout into an otherwise valid batch
preserve good code rows and all requested keys; failed code has empty rows and error metadata
overall partial and isError=false; structured error references failed code and retryable=true
all-code failure is failed/isError=true, with machine errors and no usable success claim

core_cases.name: Partial historical interval
assertions: one code with a bar on only one day of a required four-day interval is not complete
an out-of-history gap is not PRE_LISTING; not-published is not SUSPENDED
one missing/duplicate/malformed date cannot be silently dropped to improve quality
expected_rows=available_rows+gaps when all counts are known

core_cases.name: Units, precision and row integrity
assertions: stock volume shares, ETF fund_units, amount CNY proven from upstream conversion
decimal price/amount strings round-trip, volume is safe nonnegative integer; no NaN/Infinity/scientific notation
raw OHLC positive and internally ordered; negative amount/volume rejected
missing required core numeric field cannot pass by null/zero substitution

core_cases.name: Source time and finality
assertions: retrieved_at/served_at/source_updated_at/published_at remain distinct
unknown source time/provider remains null and is listed in unknown_fields
final rows reference verifiable finality_evidence; after-close retrieval alone is insufficient
preliminary bars may be valid observations but project rejects them for final close publication

core_cases.name: Trading calendar boundaries
assertions: exchange/start/end match query, dates sorted unique and bounded
range beyond verified calendar returns OUT_OF_CALENDAR, never weekday extrapolation
range longer than legacy 400-day limit returns complete or explicit error, never silent truncation
public calendar identity/version and verified natural-day boundaries supplied

core_cases.name: Universe scope and time
assertions: equity-only list contains no ETF; mixed requested scope labels each asset
total=len(data), unique instrument ids, source exhausted before universe_complete
current list with past as_of fails UNSUPPORTED_AS_OF unless historical identity is implemented
provider universe completeness is not advertised as independently verified exchange fullmarket coverage

core_cases.name: Snapshot replay and subset
assertions: capture, change upstream, then replay same snapshot: original rows/sources/retrieved_at unchanged
subset securities/date/projection reads original snapshot only
snapshot scope expansion fails SNAPSHOT_SCOPE_MISMATCH
expire/miss/restart-loss returns explicit snapshot error; never fetch new values under old id
actual retention at least seven days (configuration plus storage-expiry tests; no need fake elapsed time)

core_cases.name: Hashes and normalized query
assertions: request_hash and data_hash match canonical_json_v1 including UTF-8/key order/decimal strings
single and one-element array normalize to same query when snapshot and other arguments match
tampered price, row count or query changes hash and fails validator
all hashes are lower-case SHA256 and no floating point is hashed

core_cases.name: MCP error and dual payload agreement
assertions: structuredContent equals parsed sole JSON text block for v3
failed tool -> isError=true; partial -> isError=false plus incomplete envelope
invalid JSON-RPC methods/transport errors remain protocol errors
client preserves machine errors even when MCP result isError=true

core_cases.name: Service timeout and resource recovery
assertions: inject upstream work longer than configured <=30-second total deadline
request fails SOURCE_TIMEOUT within deadline plus bounded scheduler allowance recorded in report
work is cancelled or isolated, not an endlessly occupied thread holding every slot
after failed request, initialize/tools/list/status and ordinary Kline recover without container restart

core_cases.name: Bounded concurrency and health isolation
assertions: at declared max concurrency, one additional request gets bounded BUSY or a bounded queue response
cached status local p95<=2s over >=20 calls during slow-load injection
health/listing do not synchronously call every upstream
20-cycle handshake/status/public-Kline sequence records no unexplained disconnect; no tight infinite loop

core_cases.name: Session, SSE and restart negotiation
assertions: JSON and SSE both supported and paired by request id
interleaved SSE notification cannot replace the requested result
notification empty success accepted; invalid/mismatched response id rejected
after session expiry/restart client reinitializes and checks capability/version before collecting

core_cases.name: Capability refusal and dataset gates
assertions: profiles all explicitly supported/unsupported with reason and exact assets/frequencies/fq/history bounds
missing optional research/board-open tool does not block core daily client
1m->5m, board->stock, fq->none substitutions never occur
latest_trade_date/ready summary alone does not mark a dataset or project daily workflow complete

core_cases.name: Legacy compatibility and deployment proof
assertions: old requests without contract_version preserve documented result form and valid behavior
v3 fields/schema truly deployed under reported build id
legacy L01/L02/L03 underlying defects investigated with regression tests; root cause supported by code/log evidence
software version/source commit/image identity/config and previous deploy rollback target provided

core_cases.name: Project daily and close integration
assertions: existing prices/kline/daily share validated public input; close equals same daily snapshot close
project records actual provider, snapshot/factor references, NAS hits and explicit fallback reason
collect -> validate -> public ODS -> DWD/DWS/ADS -> data_core reads all pass in isolated warehouse
private facts stay local; service completion does not assert project production switch

core_cases.name: Scope, publication and observation
assertions: selected local watch scope and fullmarket scope distinguished; debug limit/codes cannot masquerade as full universe
unknown/errors/truncation quarantine incomplete products instead of complete publication
applicable StockDB tests and source-boundary/data-product audits pass
before dataset promotion, >=5 consecutive actual trading days observed with source/coverage/retry/replay evidence; no synthetic prior runs
freeze SH/SZ/BJ equity universe with identity/as_of evidence
per code x trading date coverage includes proven terminal states
current ST/name/list cannot substitute point-in-time historical state
if profile unsupported, explicit refusal; project keeps existing independent quality gate
same native numeric code across stock/index never aliases
BK/TI/SW namespace, methodology and historical series independent
membership mapping success is not index-history support
unsupported series returns explicit error; no cross-provider point/history stitching
each declared interval uses Beijing bar-end labels and declared auction/session boundary
1m never satisfied with 5m; row timestamps/coverage exact
session interruptions/missing minutes explained, not filled
unsupported period rejected and cannot pass by changing result frequency
v3 factor schema shipped and tested separately from Kline rows
same raw bars + factor snapshot + explicit anchor reproduce adjusted OHLC using affine-v1 to stated precision
anchor multiplier=1 and offset=0; volume/amount remain unadjusted
factor revision creates new snapshot, old replay immutable; unsupported formula/profile explicitly rejected
historical list/alias/listing/delisting validity has public evidence and real known times where available
current constituent list cannot be used as historical membership
distinguish post-hoc reproducibility from historically available information
unsupported historical as_of yields explicit refusal
